Personal influences

Heroes

People whose work makes me want to build things, or find out how they did it.

Linus Torvalds

Says it as he sees it. His attitude can be wrong, but it's honest. Created Linux, then almost incidentally created Git.

Scott Hanselman

I enjoy his content and interviews. A great ambassador for Microsoft, and not afraid to say what he thinks.

Mark Russinovich

Grew up reading his Sysinternals blogs. Always get something out of his interviews. This guy is just awesome.

John Carmack

Quake. And he knows the tech matters.

Geoff Crammond

Every game he made was great. Such fond memories of Stunt Car Racer on the Amiga.

Ian Bell & David Braben

Elite. That alone is enough. Finding out Braben was a founding trustee of the Raspberry Pi Foundation was a surprise. Very cool.

Anders Hejlsberg

Really enjoyed watching him on Channel 9, before it got commercialised.

Bart De Smet

Loved watching him explain Reactive Extensions on Channel 9. Both the ideas and how he explained them.

David Fowler

Just too clever for school.

Fabrice Bellard

I literally couldn't believe his CV when I read his website.

Andrej Karpathy

Seems very balanced in the world of AI.

Dave Cutler

Windows NT was so good compared to Windows 95 and the like. Literally awesome.

Richard Branson

A business leader I think I could trust.
